requirements: Inspect full schedulability/server/multiprocessor proof assumptions and exact selected C-edition changes; derive valid feasibility intervals and jitter/blocking models.
bindings.clause_analysis: The source-bound schedulability successors state and derive their actual premises: one preemptive CPU, fixed priorities, a per-window higher-priority arrival bound, blocking charged once and monotone response-time iteration; finite demand checks are not promoted to universal necessity. For independent constrained-deadline integer-period tasks, the partition adapter supplies a finite feasibility argument using a common-multiple H, dbf(t+H)=dbf(t)+sum(H/P)*C and service at most H; jitter, blocking, migration and locks require separate models. Exact global-EDF sequential-job/Dhall and partition counterexamples, old sporadic-server premature-credit counterexample, unit-cohort/debt recovery and soft-CBS versus Linux-throttling distinctions are implemented and executed. The inspected CBS paper delegates its complete isolation proof to TR98-01; the revised2011 sporadic-server report and that technical report remain inaccessible in the recorded attempts. Consequently the original full-proof source parent remains partial, even though these bounded derived mechanisms are complete. Exact published C wording remains a separate source gap.

evidence_limits: Modular ordering requires independently justified half-range provenance and observation intervals; raw pairs cannot detect arbitrary missed wraps.
The71,216 independent rows and finite reprogram traces falsify named defects but do not prove every schedule.
Actual QEMU instruction-clock timer counts and deliberate SysTick disable are emulator observations, not physical low-power entry, energy or worst-case interrupt latency.
The adapter implements24-bit chunking; this campaign does not separately exercise a deadline exceeding one hardware counter chunk.
Inspected upstream QEMU10.2.1 source identifies model behavior; the installed distribution patch set was not exhaustively audited.
The recorded PM0214 single-shot wording inconsistency is not silently treated as a resolved exact physical-cycle guarantee.
